Frota: Atuar na gestão e monitoramento de frota agregada com ênfase em manutenção da frota atual e captação de novos agregados para ampliação da operação e novos negócios.

Multas: Garantir as saídas dos veículos nos horários pré-estabelecidos pelo cliente, evitando multas e No show.

Tratamento de ocorrências - demora na descarga, devolução, faltas, avarias, pedido errado, pagamento de descarga, falta de agendamento, entrega sem pedido

Alinhamento Operacional - particularidades das entregas e utilização do App Cliente pelos agregados (carga agendada, limite de horário de descarga, restrição de horário, eventos)

Rotas e entregas: Supervisionar e coordenar todas as atividades relacionadas ao transporte, incluindo o planejamento de rotas, programação de entregas e notas fiscais e coordenação de motoristas e veículos.

Normas de Segurança: Garantir o cumprimento de todas as regulamentações e normas de segurança relacionadas ao transporte da frota terceirizada, incluindo a manutenção adequada dos veículos.

Fluxo de trabalho: Gerenciar o fluxo de trabalho e priorizar as entregas de acordo com a urgência e os requisitos do cliente.

Indicador de performance: Acompanhar o indicador de performance emitido pelo cliente e monitorar o desempenho dos motoristas, fornecendo feedback e sugerindo plano de ação com foco em melhoria para garantir a eficiência e a segurança das operações.

Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de transporte e implementar soluções para aumentar a eficiência e reduzir os custos.

Comunicação: Colaborar com outros departamentos, como logística, operações e atendimento ao cliente, para garantir uma comunicação eficaz e a satisfação do cliente.

Situações emergenciais: Resolver quaisquer problemas ou emergências que possam surgir durante as operações de transporte, garantindo que as entregas sejam concluídas dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.

Requisitos:

Ensino médio completo, desejável Formação em Logística, Administração ou área relacionada.

Experiência prévia em funções similares na área de transporte, preferencialmente em empresas de logística ou transporte de carga.

title: Analista de Sales Operations (Sales Ops)
description:
Sua Missão:
Transformar a área de vendas em uma operação baseada em dados e eficiência, elevando as taxas de fechamento e contribuindo para o crescimento da empresa. Você atuará como o elo entre a estratégia e sua aplicação prática, eliminando ruídos e aumentando a produtividade do time de vendas.

Sua atuação será nos bastidores, mas você precisa amar a área e as métricas de vendas, usando ferramentas para levantar e analisar dados. Com isso, poder descobrir eventuais falhas nos processos, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e indicar as melhores estratégias para a equipe de vendas, tudo com a finalidade de tornar o time de vendas mais produtivo, focado em fazer negócios melhores.

Você ajudará também a pensar em marketing ops, no que cabe os indicadores de geração de demanda via inbound e outras origens de negócios para o time comercial, auxiliando a definir os processos e tecnologias necessários para que a área funcione da melhor maneira possível.

Você atuará com o CRM do Hubspot, tanto em vendas, quanto em marketing.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Análise de Dados:

    • Analisar diariamente as métricas de vendas (aquisição e expansão) e marketing vinculadas ao processo de vendas dentro do Hubspot.
    • Responsável pelo acompanhamento e análise semanal e mensal da performance de vendas.
    • Identificar, rastrear e comunicar KPIs sobre o desempenho de vendas da divisão para a alta gerência.
    • Ser o braço direito na análise de dados do líder de vendas.
    • Tratar e entregar visões de análises para o analista de negócios de Revenue Ops.
    • Duvidar dos números e resultados, sempre garantindo a integridade dos dados.

  2. Alinhamento Estratégico:

    • Atuar nas dimensões estratégicas, táticas e operacionais da empresa, lidando com C-level, gerentes e time de vendas.
    • Fazer o alinhamento entre a estratégia e sua aplicação no mercado para eliminar ruídos e aumentar a eficácia e produtividade da equipe.
    • Implementar e manter um processo claro de gerenciamento de pipeline.
    • Apoiar a definição de metas de vendas trimestrais e atividades de previsão com desenvolvimento de negócios e operações de vendas.
    • Propor sugestões sobre o processo de vendas com base em análise de dados.
    • Ser proativo na identificação de novas oportunidades de melhorias no processo de vendas (aquisição e expansão) por meio das análises de dados.

  3. Suporte ao Time:

    • Garantir que o time de vendas esteja preenchendo corretamente o CRM e outros sistemas relacionados (Apollo), atuando como o guardião do CRM.
    • Ser solícito para esclarecer dúvidas sobre o Hubspot e entendimento de métricas para o time.
    • Organizar capacitações sobre o Hubspot para o time e coordenar junto ao líder de vendas.
    • Ajudar no onboarding de novos colaboradores no uso do Hubspot.
    • Supervisionar dados de comissão de vendas e programas de incentivo.
    • Participar dos ritos semanais do time de marketing e vendas às segundas e sextas, além das dailies.
    • Responder às demandas internas do time de modo ágil e solícito;
    • Cumprir prazos e cronogramas.

  4. Gestão do Conhecimento:

    • Organizar a gestão de conhecimento do Hubspot em formato de playbooks para que seja de fácil acesso e entendimento do time.
    • Gerenciar todos os relatórios, melhorias e modificações do sistema de CRM.
    • Usará o clickup para sua autogestão e gestão das entregas;

  5. Automação e Otimização:

    • Identificar oportunidades de automação para suportar o crescimento rápido.
    • Supervisionar dados de comissão de vendas e programas de incentivo.

Qualificações Necessárias:

  1. Mínimo de 2 anos como Sales Ops atuando em Hubspot.

  2. Mínimo de 2 anos em empresas SaaS B2B e Outbound Sales.

  3. Conhecimento intermediário de Hubspot, Excel e SQL.

  4. Experiência em análise de métricas SaaS, de vendas e marketing.

  5. Experiência na construção de KPI´s na área de vendas e marketing.

Diferenciais:

  1. Certificação em Hubspot.
  2. Experiência em Retailtechs ou startups que vendem SaaS para médias e grandes empresas.
  3. Uso de inteligência artificial para propor melhorias nos processos.
  4. Forte habilidade com Excel, tecnologia e sistemas de vendas.
  5. Comprovação de sucesso como Sales Ops.

You’ll work across multiple product teams to drive a strategic shift: from QA as a safety net to quality as a shared responsibility, embedded into every part of the development lifecycle.

You’ll lead efforts to identify critical coverage gaps, implement and scale test automation frameworks, and roll out self-service tools that enable developers to write, run, and promote tests with confidence. You’ll partner closely with embedded QAs, developers, and platform teams to shift QA towards an enablement model that amplifies impact across teams.

You’ll help pilot new ways of working that reduce manual effort, catch defects earlier, and improve the signal-to-noise ratio in our CI pipeline—whether through smarter automation, better tooling, or new AI-integrated approaches to test reliability and triage. Ultimately, your work will help Carta move faster without sacrificing confidence—by making automated quality an invisible but essential part of our software delivery process.

The Team You'll Work With

The QA Organization consists of ~15 QAs who work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Support teams. We work cross-functionally across the organization to make sure we are testing our product before our clients get to use them. This is a highly visible and critical role to help define and implement QA processes within different teams, plus help with manual and automation testing to test our products thoroughly and deliver with high quality.

About You

  • Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication skills (we communicate closely with global teams on a daily basis!)
  • 6-8+ years of experience in software engineering or automation engineering role
  • Strong programming expertise in one OOP language like Python, Java, JS or Go (Python preferred)
  • Experience building and maintaining test frameworks using tools like Selenium/Webdriver, Pytest, Cypress, Playwright
  • Deep practical understanding of test strategies (unit, integration, E2E, performance, load testing).
  • Understanding of CI/CD and hands on experience with building and deployment tools (CircleCI, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Docker) and test analytics (e.g., Datadog, Sentry)
  • Strong experience with automation and software design patterns, with proven experience in both backend and frontend projects
  • Strong knowledge in cloud infrastructure and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred)
  • You have the ability to understand the technical needs for the teams and help them implement QA processes and mindset
  • You are a self-starter who thrives on solving open-ended problems, not just executing Jira tickets
  • You identify patterns and recurring issues proactively and build scalable solutions to reduce future friction
  • You have a history of shipping test frameworks or systems used by others beyond your immediate team.
  • You have a track record of advancing quality maturity by shifting QA from hands-on execution to developer enablement through self-service tooling and process improvements
  • You are passionate about mentoring junior level team members to help them grow and learn

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. Most of Carta’s long‑term success will come from products and technology that have yet to be built. Here is an incomplete list of how you might contribute:

  • Building customer‑facing enterprise tools for equity administration

  • Reinforcing service resiliency, availability, and fault tolerance
  • Streamlining the creation of new features and services within our ecosystem
  • Integrating with third‑party vendors to provide reliable, accurate, and timely transfers of billions of dollars per year through Carta's platform
  • Refactoring existing features into standalone event‑driven services

The Team You’ll Work With

This role sits on our Data Integrations team, building the necessary network infrastructure for the flow of financial and HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) data into and out of Carta, powering the entire company management experience.

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross‑functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and correct.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
  • You have full stack experience, specifically with Typescript and any backend language.
  • You may be familiar with some additional elements of the Carta tech stack (Python, Django, React, Postgres, gRPC, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS).

The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list). Finally, you'll have back‑to‑back conversations with Carta team members on a wide range of topics, including communications and collaboration, coding efficacy and techniques, and systems design.

Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an "automation-first" senior technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have experience of IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

Job Summary

The IS team at Canonical supports and maintains all of Canonical's IT production services. The team is in charge of running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users.

As an Senior SRE & Gitops engineer you'll be in a unique position to drive operations automation to the next level, both in our own private clouds as well as in the public clouds. We do this by utilizing the best of open source infrastructure as code software, software development practices such as CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical's leading products for software operation automation.

In addition to defining the infrastructure as code, you will improve Canonical products and the open-source technologies they're based on by providing critical feedback to developers on how their products operate at scale. This is done by submitting bugs (and sometimes writing pull requests) and collaborating on design and implementations with other teams within the company.

You'll be part of a global team of SREs that work together and support each other to provide the best possible services to our company, Canonical's customers and the Ubuntu Community.

As a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer you will

  • Drive the development of automation, Gitops in your team as an embedded tech lead
  • Closely collaborate with the IS architect to align your solutions with the IS architecture vision
  • Design and architect services that IS can offer to the organization as products
  • Apply your experience of IaC to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS by constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes
  • Automate software operations for re-usability and consistency across private and public clouds, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems
  • Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical's core services, networks, and infrastructure
  • Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation, Setting up, maintaining and using observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design, implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for various systems and services
  • Provide assistance and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peers
  • Be given uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasks
  • Share your experience, know-how and best practices with other team members in design sessions, mentorship and 'doing work together'
  • Carry final responsibility for time-critical escalations

What we are looking for in you

  • A modern view on hosting architecture, driven by infrastructure as code across both private and public clouds.
  • A product mindset thriving to develop products rather than solutions.
  • Python software development experience, with large projects
  • Experience working with Kubernetes or other container orchestration systems.
  • Proven exposure to manage and deploy cloud infrastructure with code.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls
  • Affinity with various forms of Linux storage, from Ceph to Databases
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux servers
  • Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts and technologies
  • Bachelor's degree or greater, preferably in computer science or related engineering field
  • Able to communicate clearly and effectively in English over email, chat, video or voice calls and in-person
  • Motivated and able to troubleshoot from kernel to web, and willing to ask others when appropriate
  • A willingness to be flexible and able to learn new things quickly
  • Be inspired by the needs of fast-changing environments
  • Happy to work within distributed teams
  • Be passionate and familiarized about open-source, especially Ubuntu or Debian

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

About Donorbox

Donorbox is a leading fundraising platform and donor management system for nonprofit organizations. Our mission is to accelerate positive impact worldwide by helping nonprofits become highly effective at raising funds and managing their supporter base. Since 2014, we have powered more than 100,000 global organizations to close to $3B in donations.

Our fast-growing company is profitable and bootstrapped with a healthy run rate. We have a fully distributed and diverse 150-person team based in 16+ states and 23+ countries.

Donorbox is rated the #1 software for fundraising, donor management, and nonprofit payment on G2 based on hundreds of verified customer reviews. We're proud of what we do, and our product reflects it!

The Role

Donorbox is seeking a Product Analyst to join our growing team. Reporting directly to the Director of Product, the person will be a key player in helping our product teams make data-driven decisions. The role's primary focus will be on defining, implementing, and analyzing product metrics such as in-app events and conversion funnels. The person will also be responsible for ensuring the integrity and accuracy of our data collection, acting as a crucial link between our Product and Data departments. They will work closely with product managers and designers to provide the insights they need to build and iterate on successful features, and track the key results for each objective of every product team.

Responsibilities

  • Define and track key product success metrics across various product teams, including quarterly OKRs.
  • Work with product managers to establish, implement, and analyze product conversion funnels.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure accurate and complete data collection for all new product launches and feature updates.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for product usage data requests from the design team, providing them with the necessary insights to inform their decisions.
  • Bridge the communication and technical gap between the Product and Data departments, translating business needs into data requirements.
  • Monitor data quality and integrity, troubleshooting and resolving any issues related to event tracking or data loss.
  • Assist in setting up and analyzing A/B tests and other experimental feature rollouts.
  • Prepare and present regular reports and dashboards on product performance to stakeholders.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Product Analyst or in a similar data-focused role.
  • Deep expertise in web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM).
  • Hands-on experience with advanced product analytics tools like Heap, Posthog, or Pendo, including successful implementation and ongoing use.
  • Experience with A/B testing and feature rollout platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen eye for detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across different teams.
  • Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI).
  • Experience with SQL for data querying and analysis.

Bonus

  • Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and technologies.
  • Experience in a high-growth or startup environment.
  • Knowledge of scripting languages like Python or R for data analysis.
  • Background in user experience (UX) or product design.
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies.

Details

  • Fully remote based in Latin America
  • Salary: $25k-$35k USD, depending on experience and location

Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote work from the comfort of your home
  • Eligibility for employee equity plan (stock options)
  • Reimbursement package for home office expenses and professional development, up to $1.5k
  • Health insurance premium reimbursements, up to 75% for you and your family
  • Generous time off policy of 21 days (birthday included ), 8 holidays of your choice, and 2 paid volunteer days
  • Wellness program with fitness and mindfulness classes
  • Love your work and our mission of serving nonprofits!

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Customer Success - Team Manager.

To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to help our team of Customer Success Managers across regions. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success and an obvious passion for new technologies. Ideally, you have been a Customer Success Manager at one point in your career and naturally evolved to a leading position.

You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you are to provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. You are comfortable dealing with ambiguity and quickly adapt to changes. You seek collaboration with other teams to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility is to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work hand-in-hand with the Head of Customer Success.

CSMs engage a diverse customer base and follow diverse CSM motions to provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer. The right candidate would adapt to this diversity and bring broad experience to the team.

Location: This is a globally remote role

The role entails:

  • Strategic planning and analysis: preparing communication plans, Team Meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive upsells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.
  • Customer interactions and support to your team: you resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention. You work closely with your team members to ensure timely resolution.
  • Team management: you are passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. You are ready for regular performance reviews with team members. While your help in identifying areas for improvement is key, you are asked to celebrate excellence, recognise your team's achievements, and set goals for individual growth within the team.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.
  • Documentation and reporting: you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.

What we are looking for in you

  • Excellent academic results at school and university
  • Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM
  • Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries
  • Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results
  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
  • Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration
  • Experience growing and developing a CSM team
  • Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement

We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. description:

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. Our team has delivered billions of dollars in trackable revenue across e‑commerce, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs, accelerating results through high‑impact digital strategies that unlock revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

The Role

We are hiring a Design Director—a visionary leader with a strong design background, driving high‑quality design execution across various platforms and managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

Responsibilities
  • Lead 1–3 UI/UX engagements, focusing on branded e‑commerce websites.

Qualifications

  • Self‑motivated, proactive, detail‑oriented with strong sense of ownership.
  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.
  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

Remote & Compensation

Fully remote role operating in EST time zone, 100% conducted in English. Benefits include flexible parental leave, remote‑first culture, growth opportunities, autonomy with accountability, and a high‑bar performance environment.

Equal Opportunity

Darkroom is an equal‑opportunity workplace—dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

description:
Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"). Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Key Responsibilities
  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub‑projects.
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement and customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country.
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with involved government authorities to ensure smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders.
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking within the warehouse and across all venues where assets are provided by Logistics.
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing and delivery.
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities; movements of team luggage and equipment to/from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities.
  • Managing the entry of delivery and collection vehicles into venues during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS).
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including unloading services, determining storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside venues, and provision of FFE.
  • Where required, development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP), and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM).
  • Procurement and management of golf‑cart pool at venues.
  • Development of a dissolution strategy in cooperation with tournament management, legal, procurement and all item‑procurement functional areas.
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking and people resources as required.
  • Managing established contracts (LSP, FFE‑ and golf‑cart provider) and ensuring all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met.
  • Providing the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration‑management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required.
  • Attending site/venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meetings and events where an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g., Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops).
  • Creating and managing the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Creating and managing the Event Logistics project plan, including mitigation and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Recruiting the Logistics team and providing leadership to the team.
  • Preparing and managing a health‑and‑safety plan.
  • Preparing and managing a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project.
  • Providing timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management.
  • Completing the final reconciliation, closing contracts and transferring knowledge post‑tournaments.
Your Profile
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics or event operations for an international event.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and project management processes.
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills.
  • Able to work in a fast‑paced, multi‑level, project‑based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery.
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence.
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

Mid‑Senior level

Contract

Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. To do this well, we must continuously raise the bar on software quality—without compromising developer velocity.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer II , you won’t just be writing tests—you’ll be a force multiplier for quality across the engineering organization. You’ll work across multiple product teams to drive a strategic shift: from QA as a safety net to quality as a shared responsibility, embedded into every part of the development lifecycle.

You’ll lead efforts to identify critical coverage gaps, implement and scale test automation frameworks, and roll out self-service tools that enable developers to write, run, and promote tests with confidence. You’ll partner closely with embedded QAs, developers, and platform teams to shift QA towards an enablement model that amplifies impact across teams.

You’ll help pilot new ways of working that reduce manual effort, catch defects earlier, and improve the signal-to-noise ratio in our CI pipeline—whether through smarter automation, better tooling, or new AI-integrated approaches to test reliability and triage. Ultimately, your work will help Carta move faster without sacrificing confidence—by making automated quality an invisible but essential part of our software delivery process.

The Team You'll Work With

The QA Organization consists of ~15 QAs who work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Support teams. We work cross-functionally across the organization to make sure we are testing our product before our clients get to use them. This is a highly visible and critical role to help define and implement QA processes within different teams, plus help with manual and automation testing to test our products thoroughly and deliver with high quality.

About You
  • Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication skills (we communicate closely with global teams on a daily basis!)
  • 6-8+ years of experience in software engineering or automation engineering role

  • Strong knowledge in cloud infrastructure and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred)
  • You have the ability to understand the technical needs for the teams and help them implement QA processes and mindset
  • You are a self-starter who thrives on solving open-ended problems, not just executing Jira tickets
  • You identify pattern and recurring issues proactively and build scalable solutions to reduce future friction
  • You have a history of shipping test frameworks or systems used by others beyond your immediate team.
  • You have a track record of advancing quality maturity by shifting QA from hands‑on execution to developer enablement through self-service tooling and process improvements
  • You are passionate about mentoring junior level team members to help them grow and learn

Job Description

Job Number:

General Manager (Hilton Barra Rio de Janeiro) (Job Number:HOT0BOG6 )

Work Locations

Work Locations: Hilton Barra Rio de Janeiro Avenida Abelardo Bueno Barra

A General Manager is responsible for managing the Hotel Executive team and overall hotel targets to deliver an excellent Guest and Member experience while managing profitability and guest satisfaction measures.

A General Manager is responsible for managing the Hotel Executive team and overall hotel targets to deliver an excellent Guest and Member experience while managing profitability and guest satisfaction measures.



What will I be doing?

As a General Manager, you are responsible for managing the Hotel Executive team and overall hotel targets to deliver an excellent Guest and Member experience. A General Manager will also be required to manage profitability and guest satisfaction measures. Specifically, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Manage ongoing profitability of your hotel, ensuring revenue and guest satisfaction targets are met and exceeded
  • Lead in all key property issues including capital projects, customer service, and refurbishment
  • Ensure all decisions are made in the best interest of the hotels and Hilton
  • Deliver achievable hotel budgets, and set other short- and long- term strategic goals for the property
  • Provide effective leadership to hotel team members
  • Lead in all aspects of business planning
  • Comply with and exceed Hilton Brand Service Standards
  • Ensure costs are controlled and revenue opportunities are effectively sourced and delivered
  • Manage and develop the Hotel Executive team to ensure career progression and effective succession planning within Hilton
  • Hold regular briefings and communication meetings with the HOD team
  • Respond to audits to ensure continual improvement is achieved
What are we looking for?

A General Manager serving Hilton brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • Experience as General Manager or Director of Operations within a similar quality hotel
  • Degree or diploma in Hotel Management or equivalent
  • Possesss strong commercial acumen, with experience in increasing profitability
  • Experience managing budgets, revenue proposals, and forecasting results in a similar sized property
  • Excellent leadership skills
  • Exceptional communication skills
  • In-depth knowledge of the hotel/leisure/service sector

It would be advantageous in this position for you to demonstrate the following capabilities and distinctions:

  • General Management experience in a similar quality hotel


What will it be like to work for Hilton?

Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full-service hotels and resorts to extended-stay suites and mid-priced hotels. For nearly a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travelers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands . Our vision “to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality” unites us as a team to create remarkable hospitality experiences around the world every day. And, our amazing Team Members are at the heart of it all!

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

A Diffucap oferece um ambiente de trabalho ético, moderno e colaborativo para profissionais que transformam dados de mercado, prescrição, vendas, produtividade e canais em insights, com estrutura híbrida e foco em resultados sustentáveis.

Responsabilidades da Oportunidade

Objetivo do Cargo

Ser o líder da área que transforma dados de mercado, prescrição, vendas, produtividade e canais em insights , direcionando decisões estratégicas e táticas para crescimento da Diffucap. Atua como ponte entre inteligência de mercado, vendas e marketing, garantindo que os relatórios suportem o planejamento (incluindo LE trimestral), execução comercial e monitoramento de KPIs de produtividade, demanda e vendas.

Inteligência de Mercado & Prescrição

Desenvolver e manter modelos de mercado, prescrição (RX) e demanda para todas as classes terapêuticas da Diffucap.

Monitorar concorrentes, detectar tendências de mercado (entrada de genéricos, mudança de canais, novas tecnologias administrativas) e transformar em recomendações estratégicas. Exemplos: o desempenho de Deocil (via sublingual), diferenciação via canal digital, etc.

Fornecer relatórios executivos regulares para a liderança (VP Comercial, BD, Marketing) com visão de cenário, oportunidades de expansão e alertas de risco.

Produtividade Comercial & Administração de Vendas

Criar e gerir o sistema de segmentação de médicos (quadrante A, B, C, D) baseado em critérios de potencial de prescrição, margem de contribuição e uso crônico — conforme a priorização definida pela liderança comercial.

Oferecer à liderança, nas reuniões de planejamento anual (ex: plano 2026) e trimestral, o input analítico para tomada de decisão, sem necessariamente definir o “o que cada área deve fazer”, mas esclarecendo “o que o cenário exige”.

Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com Marketing, Marketing Digital, Treinamento, BD e Vendas para traduzir insights em ações — por exemplo, canais digitais complementares, influência, governança de influenciadores.

Estabelecer e manter processos de governança de dados, acesso, qualidade, periodicidade de reporte e visibilidade para todas as áreas relevantes.

title: Hardware Test & Verification Designer
description:
Corporate Recruiter at TOPIC Embedded Systems

At TOPIC (in the Netherlands) we work every day on high‑tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a highly driven and ambitious Hardware Test & Verification Designer with a passion for designing, developing, and executing cutting‑edge hardware testing, and ready to make a real impact on product quality and innovation?

“There is a lot of flexibility to educate yourself.”

Gijs van Esch I Hardware Engineer at TOPIC Embedded Systems

What will you do as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?

As a Hardware Test & Verification Designer you are responsible for designing, developing, and executing hardware testing and validation for complex embedded systems. Applies strong electronics knowledge (schematics, PCB design, signal behavior) to optimize performance and identify issues. Develops and maintains automated test scripts (Python required; LabVIEW, TestStand, or C/C++ preferred) and conducts HIL, reliability, and environmental testing.

Your responsibilities as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer:

  • Design, develop, and execute hardware testing, validation, and verification activities for embedded systems, ensuring product reliability and compliance;
  • Apply a solid understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior to identify potential issues and optimize hardware performance;
  • Conduct and support HIL (Hardware‑in‑the‑Loop) testing, as well as reliability and environmental qualification testing;
  • Collaborate closely with embedded software and firmware teams; a hands‑on programming mindset is preferred;
  • Work in a structured, plan‑oriented manner, maintaining high accuracy in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
  • Take a consultative approach, translating test results into clear and valuable recommendations for design improvements and product optimization;
  • Act as a technical consultant, capable of operating across different customer environments to ensure quality, robustness, and regulatory compliance of embedded hardware products.

What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • Strategic projects in complex high‑tech environments
  • Collaborate with other senior engineers and domain experts
  • Access to advanced training through our TOPIC Academy
  • Contribute to and lead tech events and knowledge sessions

This will make you better:

  • Permanent contract
  • An all‑in benefits package (€62,000 – €82,000 annually) including 13th month, mobility, pension, extra holidays
  • 26 vacation days (option to buy extra), pension scheme, relocation support

This will keep you healthy:

  • Good work‑life balance, flexible hours, and hybrid working
  • Inspiring office with daily fresh fruit and a gym
  • Home office support for an inspiring work‑from‑home setup
  • Regular fun, social, and sports events

What do you bring as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field;
  • 5+ years in hardware testing, validation, and verification;
  • Strong understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior;
  • Proficient in Python (required); experience with LabVIEW, TestStand, or C/C++ is a plus;
  • Familiarity with HIL testing, reliability testing, and environmental testing;
  • Affinity with embedded software and firmware; hands‑on programming skills are preferred;
  • Plan‑oriented and accurate, with strong skills in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
  • Able to interpret test results and translate them into actionable recommendations;
  • Comfortable acting as a technical consultant across various customer environments, ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of embedded hardware products;
  • A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.

Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high‑tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Embedded Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System‑on‑Chips and FPGAs.

Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

description:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why Join Us?
  • Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.
  • At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands‑on.
  • Pre-IPO & growing – We’re backed by leading VC funds including One Peak Partners, Goldman Sachs Asset Management, and Point Nine Capital, raising a total of approx. €400m to date. Now, we’re focused on profitability and IPO preparation. It’s an exciting time to join us.
  • ✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now *and* build for long‑term success.
Job Description

We are looking for a Web Analyst to join our team and help us optimize the performance of over 25 B2B websites. As a key member for the web team, you will be responsible for analyzing user behavior, tracking key website metrics, and providing actionable insights to improve MQL generation and conversion rates. Your work will directly impact our ability to make informed decisions and improve the performance of our websites.

Key Responsibilities
  • Analyze and report on website performance, focusing on conversion rates, form submissions, and user engagement.
  • Interpret data from website tracking tools (Google Analytics, VWO, Hubspot).
  • Setting and ideation for web events based on business objectives.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards to provide real‑time insights into website performance and translate data into clear, actionable recommendations for the marketing team (LookerStudio, Superset).
  • Conducting A/B testing analyses (VWO and HubSpot).
  • One‑off analysis for key initiatives like Back Friday campaign, promotions, product launches, website migrations to measure effectiveness.
  • Identify and analyze different audience segments to improve targeting and personalization.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to ensure that tracking plans are in place for all key user behaviors.
  • Collaborate with the content team to provide data driven insights that inform content creation and optimize engagement from key user segments.
Qualifications
  • 3+ years experience in web analytics, digital marketing, or CRO roles.
  • Proficiency in Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, or other web analytics platforms.
  • Ability to build dashboards and reports using Looker, Tableau, Superset or similar tools.
  • Experience with A/B testing tools like Google Optimize, VWO, or Optimizely.
  • Experience with Hotjar, Clarity, or other user behavior tracking tools.
  • Experience with Search Console or other SEO tracking tools is a plus.
  • Experience working in a fast paced, dynamic environment.
Additional Information

What to Expect from Our Hiring Process

  • ✈️ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Acquisition Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.
  • Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper dive into your experience and aspirations with your future manager, who you’ll be reporting to in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.
  • Case Study – a practical exercise to present to the Hiring Managers.
  • Reference Check & Offer!
Why You’ll Love It HereGlobal Benefits –
  • Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
  • Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
  • Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.
  • ESOP (Employee ShareOwnership Plan) after 6 months with us—because we believe in sharing our success!
Local Perks
  • Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.
Career Growth

We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross‑functional projects.

A Truly Global Team

Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You

Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You’re welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In
  • Focus on results – we’re here to make an impact.
  • Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.
  • ✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.
  • Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.
  • Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Manager, you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide.   • Product Strategy – Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for IGN’s digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company’s goals and objectives

  • Team Leadership – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high‑quality products.

  • User Experience (UX) – Work with UX/UI designers to create user‑friendly and visually appealing products. Ensure a seamless and engaging user experience across IGN’s digital platforms.

  • Product Development – Oversee the end‑to‑end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high‑quality products on schedule.
  • Project Management – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post‑launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Market and Competitive Analysis – Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and threats in the market.

  • Experience in building subscription‑based products with a track record of driving growth
  • Led product development on complex features from 1st to Nth interaction
  • A history of deep, and demonstrated understanding of the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and product delivery
  • Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well‑structured, data‑informed, written narrative
  • Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
  • Upper‑intermediate English level
NICE TO HAVES
  • Deep understanding of gaming trends
  • Strong background in app development and design
PERKS AND BENEFITS
  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever‑growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD‑based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipal, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Our client’s Microsoft Business Solutions team is a Microsoft Gold Partner and leader in Microsoft software implementations for medium to large organisations, providing their clients with the ability to keep up with the ever-changing digital world by implementing Microsoft’s M365, Azure, Microsoft’s Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Customer Engagement (CE) software from the Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) software line.

Role Overview

Our client is looking for an experienced Dynamics 365 for Finance and Operations (D365FO) Solutions Architect with extensive experience across all phases of large‑scale enterprise D365FO projects. With a hands‑on approach and proven experience in end‑to‑end implementations, strong understanding of financial and supply chain processes and procedures combined with practical knowledge of interfacing and integration with Dynamics products. A demonstrable history of consultancy experience is a must as this role will entail continuous interaction with clients, managing onshore consultants, working alongside both onshore and offshore development teams. This role will also require a level of presales activities focused on D365FO functionality and the wider Microsoft platform. You will also contribute to proposal development and provide input in business development whilst leading and mentoring more junior staff.

This role is therefore key to our client’s customer delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations solutions. It is a dynamic and exciting opportunity to join a rapidly growing business area within an established and market‑leading global Big 4 firm.

Work Type: Hybrid

Working Hours: GMT +1

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo.   • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.
Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem‑estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. title: Gerente de TI - Foco em Infraestrutura e Business Partner L'Oréal Brasil
description:
Gerente de TI - Foco em Infraestrutura e Business Partner L'Oréal Brasil

L'Oréal está presente em mais de 150 países em cinco continentes. Por mais de um século, a L'Oréal dedicou-se exclusivamente a "criar a beleza que move o mundo"; é agora a líder mundial da indústria, com vendas consolidadas de €29 bilhões. Juntos, resolvemos desafios complexos em grande escala, enquanto continuamos comprometidos em tornar o mundo um lugar mais inclusivo e melhor para todos e para o nosso planeta. Experimente a emoção da agilidade para moldar o futuro da beleza; onde diversidade e propósito se unem e criam um impacto significativo.

Missão

Em colaboração com a Equipe de TI, Divisões de Negócios e Áreas Corporativas, o Corporate BRM (Business Relationship Manager) e Client Services Lead é o principal Parceiro de Negócios para as Áreas Corporativas e também responsável pela operação transversal de serviços ao cliente no Brasil. Ele/Ela será responsável por manter o engajamento e a comunicação com os stakeholders, compreender o negócio, auxiliar na priorização de projetos, garantindo que os projetos estejam alinhados com uma tecnologia que proporcione o máximo retorno sobre o investimento.

Principais AtividadesCorporate BRM
  • Construir e gerenciar a equipe de relacionamento para garantir a convergência e a parceria estratégica com a equipe de parceiros de negócios, incluindo o trabalho próximo com a liderança de CxO como patrocinadores executivos para cada parceiro de negócios.
  • Fazer parceria com a organização de gerenciamento de projetos/programas/portfólio (PMO) para garantir um portfólio de iniciativas saudável e bem gerenciado.
  • Supervisionar o planejamento de projetos de aplicativos, execução, monitoramento de marcos, rastreamento e atualizações de status. Gerenciamento de orçamento e recursos.
  • Identificar oportunidades de funções de negócios e a posição mais apropriada para a adoção da função dentro da organização. Medir a adoção e trabalhar com a liderança Corporativa (Jurídico, RH, Sourcing, Comunicação) para desenvolver roteiros e oportunidades futuras.
  • Focar no valor de negócio em vez de soluções para desenvolver ideias, incluindo conscientização digital, avaliações de risco, continuidade de negócios e requisitos de capacidade de negócios.
  • Gerenciar as demandas internas dos clientes, atuando como mediador entre a satisfação do cliente e a viabilidade da TI (orçamento, limitações técnicas, prioridades, etc.).
Client Services Lead
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar processos de Gerenciamento de Serviços de TI, como gerenciamento de incidentes, problemas, mudanças e liberações, para alinhar-se aos objetivos de negócios. Eles supervisionam o desempenho e o alinhamento dos serviços de TI, garantem a conformidade com os padrões e SLAs, gerenciam os relacionamentos com os stakeholders e promovem uma cultura de melhoria contínua de serviços usando dados e análises.
  • Estratégia e Alinhamento de Serviços: Garantir que os serviços de TI se alinhem aos objetivos de negócios e às prioridades estratégicas, guiando a estratégia de TI e a alocação de recursos.
  • Monitoramento de Desempenho: Monitorar o desempenho dos serviços e da infraestrutura de TI para garantir que eles atinjam os objetivos, entregando o valor de negócio esperado.
  • Gerenciamento de Stakeholders: Atuar como um elo estratégico, gerenciando relacionamentos com stakeholders internos, clientes e parceiros externos.

title: Supervisor de Prevenção de Perdas I Rio de Janeiro - RJ.
description:
Job description

Nossa história resume bem o que somos: uma combinação entre nosso potencial e a dedicação de quem acredita que limites existem para serem superados.

Sabemos que para ganhar o jogo precisamos dos melhores talentos e estamos aqui para jogar a longo prazo. Por isso, procuramos pessoas que queiram evoluir continuamente e se desafiar a construir algo relevante para nossos clientes.

Foram a ambição e o trabalho dos nossos associados que nos trouxeram até aqui e que continuarão a nos levar adiante. Por isso, buscamos os melhores profissionais, que sejam obcecados por gerar resultados através do time, liderando uma equipe de alta performance.

Se identificou? Então venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Main responsibilities

Como Supervisor de Prevenção de Perdas, você fará:

  • Visitas em loja: responsável por realizar auditorias presenciais das rotinas e processos em um grupo específico de lojas, efetuando as correções e ajustes necessários para assegurar o controle e a redução de perdas e quebras nas localidades, conforme metas pré-estabelecidas.
  • Tratativa dos indicadores críticos: responsável por monitorar, através de painel de indicadores e imagens, as informações atreladas a perdas e quebras das lojas, identificando possíveis desvios e agindo proativamente para corrigi-los.
  • Investigação de fraudes e desvios: responsável por apurar fraudes, quebras de procedimentos e desvios de mercadorias nas lojas através do canal de denúncias, visitas em loja e análise do painel de indicadores.
  • Acompanhamento de inventário: Responsável por acompanhar a organização e preparo das lojas para a realização de inventários, diagnosticando os resultados e elaborando um plano de ação junto às lojas para melhorar esses resultados.
  • Acompanhamento dos resultados: responsável por realizar reuniões semanais, quinzenais e/ou mensais para atualizar e apresentar resultados, discutir estratégias, e treinar a equipe de prevenção e os associados das lojas nos procedimentos preventivos.
  • Atuação em sinistros: responsável por identificar e implementar ações para mitigar e reduzir ocorrências de sinistros em determinadas localidades, além de fornecer o suporte necessário à loja após um sinistro, garantindo a execução adequada do procedimento pós-sinistro e prevenindo possíveis reincidências.
Requirements and skills

Você deve ter os seguintes requisitos:

  • Graduação completa;
  • Domínio do pacote office – Intermediário/avançado;
  • Habilidade analítica e estratégica;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
  • Perfil direcionado a resultados;
  • Senso de urgência;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Será um diferencial se você possuir:

  • Conhecimento prévio em Prevenção de Perdas;
  • Vivência com Looker ou Power BI;
  • Conhecimento com sistemas de CFTV;
  • Vivência com SAP.

Local de Trabalho:

  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em Rio de Janeiro - RJ .
Additional information

  • Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;

  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Meetups e eventos com muita troca de conhecimento e uma plataforma interna com diversos cursos e treinamentos;

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

  • ⚡Own It: Espírito de dono traz liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e buscamos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
  • Live the Ride: Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com erros e vemos desafios como oportunidades de crescimento.
  • No Bullshit: Agimos com simplicidade. Somos práticos, sinceros e valorizamos feedbacks, usando transparência para evoluir, mesmo em erros.
  • Team Play: Quer ir rápido? Vá sozinho(a). Quer ir longe? Vá em equipe. Aprendemos uns com os outros, e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
  • The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos impactá-lo positivamente e ver as melhorias que trazemos à sua vida.

Sua missão vai muito além da simples oferta de crédito. Você será o principal parceiro estratégico dos empreendedores mais influentes da sua região, realizando um diagnóstico financeiro profundo de cada negócio. Com base nessa análise, você desenhará e implementará estratégias de crédito personalizadas, integrando-as a um ecossistema completo de soluções Stone em finanças, software e gestão. Seu objetivo é garantir não apenas a melhor solução de crédito, mas uma experiência de excelência que impulsione de forma decisiva o sucesso e a competitividade dos nossos clientes.

Como será seu dia a dia:

Requisitos e qualificações:
  • Sólido conhecimento em produtos de crédito e do setor financeiro;
  • Experiência em riscos de crédito na concessão de crédito e matemática financeira;
  • Habilidade em negociação e gestão de carteira;
  • Conhecimento do mercado regional e experiência em vendas;

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web utilizando Java e frameworks relacionados.

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Sobre a AXIA Energia

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN). Mais do que uma mudança de nome, a AXIA representa a evolução de uma companhia sólida, que vem se transformando para atuar com mais agilidade, inovação e foco no cliente em um setor em constante movimento. A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro. Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta. Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!

ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições Descrição do Cargo

Liderar o desenvolvimento e a implementação de modelos de análise de dados avançados e inteligência artificial no Centro de Monitoramento ATMOS. O objetivo é aprimorar o monitoramento e previsão meteorológica, como instrumento nos processos de operação e de manutenção dos ativos de geração e transmissão da AXIA Energia, utilizando insights baseados em dados para minimizar o impacto de intempéries para empresa.

Principais Atividades
  • Analisar grandes volumes de dados meteorológicos e climáticos de diversas fontes - oriundos de modelos de previsão numérica e dados operacionais (tempo real e históricos);
  • Desenvolver algoritmos preditivos baseados em treinamento de dados para reconhecer padrões e relacionamentos para eventos meteorológicos críticos;
  • Criar algoritmos e scripts para automatizar processos de análise e previsão meteorológica e climática;
  • Construir dashboards interativos e relatórios analíticos;
  • Colaborar com meteorologistas, engenheiros e analistas para interpretar os dados à luz da meteorologia aplicada à operação, gestão e manutenção de ativos de transmissão e de geração, além de outras áreas de negócio da AXIA Energia.
Requisitos e qualificações Requisitos Obrigatórios
  • Formação Superior completo em Ciência de Dados, Meteorologia, Engenharia, Estatística, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio em técnicas de Machine Learning, Modelagem Estatística e Inteligência Artificial aplicadas à meteorologia, climatologia e engenharia ambiental;
  • Proficiência em linguagens como Python ou R, com experiência em bibliotecas como Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow ou PyTorch;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, processamento de dados em tempo real e ferramentas de Big Data;
  • Excelência na criação de dashboards interativos (Power BI) e visualizações voltadas à tomada de decisão;
  • Familiaridade com arquiteturas de dados, pipelines de ETL e ambientes em nuvem (cloud).
Requisitos Desejáveis
  • Pós-graduação ou certificações em Machine Learning, Data Analytics ou Inteligência Artificial;
  • Experiência com dados meteorológicos operacionais, modelagem preditiva e integração de sistemas é um diferencial relevante.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, queremos saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, onde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:
  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space , o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!
