GERENTE DE MARKETING – Guaracamp

Guaracamp, Indústria e comércio de bebidas, há 29 anos nascidos na Zona Oeste do Rio, é a Guaraná Natural mais amado do Rio de Janeiro. Somos uma marca raiz, autêntica, com foco em resultados e paixão pelo que fazemos. Orgulho de pertencer e atitude de dono, cuidamos da empresa como se fosse nossa, agindo com senso de urgência.

A empresa disponibiliza vagas para pessoas com deficiência, conforme Art. 93, Lei 8.213/91 e art. 3º e 4º Dec.3.298-99.

OBJETIVO DO CARGO

Planejar, implementar e gerenciar estratégias de marketing voltadas para o crescimento e fortalecimento da marca, com objetivo de aumentar geração de leads, ampliar oportunidades de negócios e promover engajamento com todos os stakeholders, ampliando a presença da marca em regiões estratégicas.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES
  • Elaborar e executar planos de marketing integrados que alinhem metas de crescimento da empresa com demandas do mercado.
  • Criar e gerenciar campanhas de marketing com foco em geração de leads, vendas e fortalecimento da marca.
  • Gerir a criação de campanhas, materiais de PDV e publicações em redes sociais com a agência de propaganda parceira.
  • Garantir que todos os materiais estejam alinhados à identidade e aos valores da marca.
  • Desenvolver iniciativas para aumentar a visibilidade e relevância da marca entre stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Planejar ações específicas para fortalecer a presença da marca em regiões de alta concorrência.
  • Desenvolver materiais e cuidar de toda a identidade visual dos balcões, garantindo boa exposição da marca.
  • Implementar estratégias que promovam fidelização e aumento de vendas entre clientes existentes.
  • Criar campanhas de incentivo e ações promocionais que incentivem recompra.
  • Planejar e coordenar eventos patrocinados pela empresa, garantindo alinhamento aos objetivos de marketing e reforçando a imagem da marca.
  • Gerenciar a execução e logística dos eventos para maximizar impacto junto ao público-alvo.
  • Monitorar e avaliar desempenho das campanhas e ações de marketing, usando KPIs e métricas para identificar oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Preparar relatórios detalhados sobre impacto das estratégias e apresentar recomendações para ajustes.
HABILIDADES COMPORTAMENTAIS
  • Adaptabilidade e Resiliência
  • Comunicação Clara
  • Foco em Resultado
  • Mão na Massa e atitude de dono
  • Criatividade na solução
REQUISITOS
  • Graduação em Marketing, Administração, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em cargos de gestão na área de marketing, preferencialmente em indústrias de bens de consumo.
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de eventos e relacionamento com agências de publicidade.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de campanhas regionais para aumentar penetração de mercado em áreas concorridas.
  • Habilidades em marketing de relacionamento e fidelização de clientes.

title: OPERADOR DE MÁQUINAS
description:
A Iqony Solutions do Brasil é uma subsidiária da Iqony Solutions GmbH, fornecedor conhecido internacionalmente pelos serviços especializados no setor energético, atuando em mais de 80 países em todo o mundo. Desde 2002, a Iqony Solutions do Brasil, com sede no Rio de Janeiro, oferece seus serviços nas áreas de Engenharia, Consultoria e Operação & Manutenção para clientes na América do Sul em usinas de geração de energia. O grupo é proprietário de aproximadamente 7.6 GW de capacidade instalada, incluindo plantas Eólicas, Térmicas, Solar, entre outras. Ao lado do investidor, oferecemos as melhores soluções para Engenharia e Operação & Manutenção. Atualmente, a Iqony Solutions GmbH opera mais de 6 GW de terceiros e 7.6 GW de plantas próprias. A Iqony Solutions do Brasil também oferece serviços no setor de energias renováveis com contratos no Brasil que somam mais de 5 GW. A empresa também possui um Centro de Operação e Monitoramento Remoto, situado no Rio de Janeiro.

A IQONY Solutions do Brasil Ltda, assume o compromisso de atuação baseando-se na valorização e respeito aos direitos humanos, rejeitando todas as formas de discriminação, e está comprometida em promover e valorizar a diversidade, inclusão e equidade de tratamento em todos os níveis e processos da organização, zelando por um ambiente saudável e equilibrado de trabalho.

Nossos processos seletivos são abertos para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, orientação sexual, cor/raça, deficiências, religião, nacionalidade, naturalidade, idade ou quaisquer outras características pessoais.

Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Suas principais atividades serão:
  • Aplicar os conhecimentos técnicos de Segurança do Trabalho de modo a reduzir, neutralizar ou eliminar os riscos à segurança do trabalhador;
  • Orientar o sistema de segurança do trabalho, investigando riscos e causas de acidentes, fazendo as necessárias recomendações para evitar acidentes semelhantes, analisando esquemas de prevenção, observando dispositivos legais e institucionais que objetivem a eliminação, controle ou redução permanente dos riscos de acidentes do trabalho e a melhoria das condições do ambiente, para preservar a integridade física e mental dos trabalhadores;
  • Inspecionar locais, instalações e equipamentos da empresa e determinar fatores de riscos de acidentes;
  • Realizar auditorias internas e treinamentos de Segurança do Trabalho em todos os Setores da unidade Hospitalar, de forma rotineira, identificando condições insalubres e perigosas, tomando todas as providências necessárias para eliminar as situações de riscos, bem como orientar e conscientizar os colaboradores quanto a atitudes de segurança no trabalho;
  • Elaborar e implementar política de saúde, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente (SSMA);
  • Exigir o cumprimento das condições básicas de Segurança do Trabalho para empresas prestadoras de serviço e contratadas para execução de serviços nas dependências do estabelecimento hospitalar;
  • Acompanhar de forma permanente as atividades realizadas pela CIPA, estudando suas observações e propostas, visando a adoção das soluções corretivas e preventivas de acidentes do trabalho e meio ambiente dela valendo-se como agente multiplicador;
  • Controlar, distribuir e inspecionar os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI);
  • Elaborar documentos de segurança do trabalho como Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais, dentre outros;
  • Fazer inspeção em equipamentos de proteção contra incêndio, recursos audiovisuais e didáticos e outros materiais considerados indispensáveis, de acordo com a legislação vigente;
  • Propor normas e dispositivos de segurança, sugerindo eventuais modificações nos equipamentos e instalações e verificando sua observância, para prevenir acidentes;
  • Inspecionar os postos de combate a incêndios, examinando as mangueiras, hidrantes, extintores e equipamentos de proteção contra incêndios;
  • Comunicar os resultados de suas inspeções à coordenação do SESMT, elaborando relatórios;
  • Investigar acidentes ocorridos, examinando as condições da ocorrência, para identificar suas causas e propor as providências cabíveis;
  • Intermediar junto aos serviços médico e social da instituição, visando facilitar o atendimento necessário aos acidentados;
  • Registrar irregularidades e elaborar estatísticas de acidentes;
  • Promover campanhas, cursos, palestras e outras formas de treinamento com o objetivo de divulgar as normas de segurança e higiene do trabalho, bem como informar e conscientizar os trabalhadores sobre atividades insalubres, perigosas e penosas;

title: Network Solution Architect - Data and Voice
description:
Network Solution Architect - Data and Voice

1GLOBAL is a technology‑driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best‑in‑class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital‑first businesses—including neo‑banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

Position Overview

As an Architect inside the Network Engineering department, you will act as a Solution Architect for new products, services and technologies in 1GLOBAL, acting as a point of contact towards internal and external customers. Effectively work closely with Product and Marketing, but also with all different technical stakeholders and vendors, in shaping, designing, testing, and implementing new solutions. The Architect is responsible for leading the requirements analysis process, in close contact with all relevant stakeholders, to a refined and clear scope, allowing a solution to be created, documented and planned to be implemented.

We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.

Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.

Key Responsibilities
  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Collaborates with technical teams in defining reliable, modular, scalable, and customer‑centric solutions, as well as planning and reviewing solutions
  • Design and present solutions in documents and workshops. For the solution identifies the impacts, efforts and the resources needed
  • Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
  • Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry and identifying interesting solutions for the product portfolio
  • Definition and follow up of company technological evolution roadmaps
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and / or alternatives
  • Ensure and control quality of documentation execution (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.)
  • Ensure and control implementation quality. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Ensure the network is compliant with industry standards and regulations
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies. Enhance, simplify, and optimize existing applications and processes
  • Evolves the engineering maturity to be on par with the non‑functional and functional state‑of‑the‑art
  • Communicates transparently to the whole business
  • Reaches out to other teams and works towards alignment and overall continuous improvement
Requirements

Must Have

  • Excellent understanding of Mobile Networks and its architectures
  • Experience with MVNO architecture(s) and landscape. Familiar with roaming environment, including its technical, commercial and regulatory aspects
  • Solid knowledge of networking principles & protocols, including security
  • Experience in network protocols like MAP, CAMEL, SIGTRAN, DIAMETER, SIP
  • Knowledge and experience of OCS and Gy/Sy interfaces
  • Experience with VoLTE and VoWiFi
  • Experience with LTE, 5G, IMS, IP technologies and protocols
  • Familiar with cloud‑based solutions and virtualization technologies
  • High Level Designs and Low Level Designs. Experience developing and presenting internal and external documents
  • Experience with 5G Core Mobile Networks
  • Experience with monitoring tools and protocols in Mobile Networks
  • Anticipates problems and addresses them before they cause impact
  • Understands how big‑picture goals inform technical details and vice‑versa
  • Ability to work in complex environments (multi‑cultural/multi‑country/geographically distributed teams)
  • High attention to detail. Doesn't leave things to be addressed or left undone
  • Business oriented, capable to engage and discuss with non technical persons in order to create technical requirements
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud applications monitoring and analytics is a plus
  • Experience with AI/ML cloud based service assurance is a plus
  • Extensive working experience on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
Benefits
  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!
Why 1GLOBAL?
  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year‑on‑year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast‑paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting‑edge field
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results‑driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world’s leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL’s evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Position Overview

As a Network Architect, in the Network Team, you will be responsible to propose, analyze and define the requirements for new and existing services and systems, in the functional domain of Evolved Packet Core and 5G SA Core.

You will be responsible for preparing, designing, testing, and delivering new solutions or enhancements to the existing product portfolio.   • Elaborate, and manage the process, for change requests to current partners in order to meet the network necessities

  • Generate and implement process improvements, including and especially cross-team processes
  • Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry. Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives
Must Have
  • Proven experience on implementation of live solutions on mobile telecom (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), networks design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
  • Experience in the design, test and operation of Packet Core systems, including P-GW, RADIUS, DNS, PCRF, ePDG, DRA
  • Experience in defining, establishing and maintaining roaming interconnects for GRX/IPX
  • Understanding about IMS architecture. Experience in deploying VoLTE, VoWiFi, and QoS
  • Experience in designing, implementing, testing and troubleshooting the following interfaces: Gx, RADIUS, SGi/Gi, Gy, Bp, S6b, S2b, SWm, Sxb
  • Experience in mobile services charging (offline, online).
  • Experience in Policy control, including DPI and PCRF policy creation
  • Experience with IoT, including LTE-M and NB-IoT
  • Knowledge and experience with Diameter/SCTP networks and protocols
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as RADIUS, GTP-C, GTP-U, Diameter, MAP, S6a
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape

description:
We’re helping an international finance and M&A consultancy find a Financial Analyst to support transaction advisory, fundraising, and strategic finance projects for high-growth startups and scaleups.

You’ll build sophisticated financial models, prepare investor and board materials, and support valuation and deal execution across software and deeptech companies. This is a hands‑on, high‑accountability role where flawless work is non‑negotiable — your analyses will directly inform key decisions and client strategies.

This role is ideal for someone who is a wizard with numbers , detail‑obsessed yet commercially minded, and capable of seeing both the story and strategy behind the spreadsheets .

Part time to start, 24 hours/week (with potential to transition to full time)
Schedule: CET working hours
Location: Fully Remote
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Compensation: $1440-$2200 (based on a 24‑hour workweek, depending on level of experience); $2400-$3680 for full time

Key Responsibilities

  • Financial Modelling (Forecast & Scenario Analysis)
    Build fully linked 3‑statement financial models with sensitivities and scenarios (base, downside, management).
    Create cash flow forecasts, liquidity bridges, and valuation‑ready modules (DCF, comps, transaction comps).

  • Historical Restatement & Data Hygiene
    Reconcile and clean raw data (GL exports, bank data, SaaS metrics) into analysis‑ready formats.
    Maintain version control, audit trails, and traceability from trial balance to model.

  • Reporting Templates & Automation
    Design board and investor reporting templates, KPI dashboards, and variance analysis frameworks.
    Build SaaS metrics (ARR/MRR bridges, churn, LTV/CAC, NRR) and recurring revenue templates.

  • Transaction Support (Model‑Led)
    Produce deal‑ready schedules for buy‑side and sell‑side engagements (QofE, NWC, closing adjustments).
    Translate model outputs into charts and visuals for investment memorandums and management presentations.

  • Quality Assurance & Standards
    Follow strict QA processes (FAST/SMART methodology).
    Double‑check every formula, input, and output — your work must be flawless .
    Ensure transparency through consistent assumptions pages, error checks, and version logs.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of experience in M&A, Transaction Services, or FP&A , ideally from a Tier 1 investment bank or M&A boutique .

    • Candidates with more years of experience will also be considered if they remain flexible and open to new approaches.

  • Strong experience working with software companies ; exposure to deeptech (e.g., chipmakers) is a plus.

  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets proficiency (array formulas, Power Query, dynamic formulas, structured refs).

  • Excellent grasp of valuation and deal mechanics (NWC, closing adjustments, leakage, earn‑outs).

  • Ability to turn messy data into clear historicals and models — quickly and accurately.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills — able to explain the story behind the numbers.

  • Meticulous attention to detail and ability to self‑check work before submission.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience preparing materials for investment memorandums (IMs).

  • Familiarity with CAPEX modelling and debt structuring.

  • Previous experience in software or SaaS transactions ; exposure to deeptech deals a bonus.

How Our Client Works

  • Theyown the numbers — every figure must be backed by logic, traceability, and quality assurance.

  • Theybalance precision with practicality — models should be easy to hand over and fast to update.

  • Theytranslate numbers into narratives — this role will eventually expand into creating investment memorandums where financial insights tell the story.

Recruitment Process

  1. Initial Interview

  2. Finance Case + bonus assignment

  3. Second Interview

  4. Valuation Case Test

  5. Final Interview

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics
description:
Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops)
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health- and safety plan
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments
YOUR PROFILE
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)

Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

description:
Supervisor de Área – Grupo Lothar Descreva a Vaga

É responsável por visitar os postos conforme a rota definida, verificando a presença, postura, uniforme e equipamentos dos vigilantes, assegurando o cumprimento das normas operacionais estabelecidas. Também acompanha as escalas de trabalho, confirma a presença dos profissionais nos turnos e providencia coberturas em casos de faltas ou atrasos, realizando os devidos ajustes conforme as necessidades operacionais.

Entre suas atribuições está a aplicação de treinamentos práticos e rápidos no próprio local de trabalho (on-the-job), com foco na correção de falhas e reforço dos procedimentos de segurança. Além disso, é responsável por preencher checklists operacionais, relatar ocorrências, irregularidades e comunicar qualquer anormalidade à central ou à gerência.

Realiza vistorias nos equipamentos utilizados pelos vigilantes, como rádios comunicadores, lanternas, sistemas de CFTV e alarmes, garantindo que todos estejam funcionando corretamente e que os profissionais estejam com os EPIs e materiais exigidos para a função.

Durante ocorrências, o supervisor presta apoio direto à equipe, atuando em casos como invasões, furtos ou acidentes, acionando as autoridades competentes quando necessário e registrando os fatos de forma clara e precisa.

Mantém contato frequente com os responsáveis nos locais de vigilância, avaliando a satisfação do cliente em relação aos serviços prestados e repassando os feedbacks à gestão. Além disso, realiza inspeções surpresa para verificar a conduta dos vigilantes, o cumprimento de horários e a execução correta das rotinas nos postos.

We are looking for a Sales Engineering Delivery Manager with 3+ years of experience to connect prospective clients and internal teams. Strong knowledge of business strategy, the SDLC, and excellent communication skills are essential.

  • Proposal Development & Deliverable Creation:
    • Develop dynamic, visually compelling presentation decks and engagement proposals that clearly articulate service offerings, project scope, value propositions, and strategic recommendations.
    • Customize deliverables to reflect client‑specific challenges and opportunities uncovered during discovery meetings.
    • Integrate technical insights with business strategy, ensuring that proposals account for both immediate deliverables and long‑term client growth.
  • Team Buildout and Project Kickoff:
    • Act as the primary point of coordination among Sales, Recruiting, and Engineering teams, ensuring smooth hand‑offs from initial engagement through team buildout to project kick‑off.
    • Serve as a “concierge” for deals, maintaining fluid communication and alignment across functions to drive successful client onboarding.
    • Serve as a trusted advisor during pre‑sales engagements by translating complex technical aspects into digestible, business‑focused narratives.
    • Maintain a sales/consulting mindset throughout the technical discovery process, ensuring proposals align with targeted business outcomes.

description:
About Docplanner Group

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. Job Description

We are looking for a Web Analyst to join our team and help us optimize the performance of over 25 B2B websites. As a key member for the web team, you will be responsible for analyzing user behaviour, tracking key website metrics, and providing actionable insights to improve MQL generation and conversion rates. Your work will directly impact our ability to make informed decisions and improve the performance of our websites.

Key Responsibilities
  • Analyze, and report on website performance, focusing on conversion rates, form submissions, and user engagement.

  • Conducting A/B testing analyses (VWO and HubSpot).
  • One‑off analysis for key initiatives like Back Friday campaign, promotions, product launches, website migrations to measure effectiveness.
  • Identify and analyse different audience segments to improve targeting and personalisation.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to ensure that tracking plans are in place for all key user behaviours.
  • Collaborate with the content team to provide data‑driven insights that inform content creation and optimise engagement from key user segments.
Qualifications
  • 3+ years experience in web analytics, digital marketing, or CRO roles.
  • Proficiency in Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, or other web analytics platforms.
  • Ability to build dashboards and reports using Looker, Tableau, Superset or similar tools.
  • Experience with A/B testing tools like Google Optimize, VWO, or Optimizely.
  • Experience with Hotjar, Clarity, or other user behaviour tracking tools.
  • Experience with Search Console or other SEO tracking tools is a plus.
  • Experience working in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.
Hiring Process
  1. Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Acquisition Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper dive into your experience and aspirations with your future manager.
  3. Case Study – a practical exercise to present to the Hiring Managers.

  • Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.

Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

Career Growth

We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross‑functional projects.

Global Team

Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility

Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. About Nubank’s Mobile Platform and App Core

The Mobile Platform’s mission aligns with Nubank’s commitment to delivering the best experience for our customers by ensuring a high-performing, stable, and seamless app.

Within Mobile Platform, App Core focuses on providing user-friendly, scalable, high-performing, and cost-efficient app infrastructure components and mobile tools that enable Nubank engineers to quickly and safely test, deploy, monitor, analyze, and improve app flows and features.

App Core is at the heart of the Nubank app’s foundation, powering app performance, infrastructure scalability, and the removal of legacy dependencies to allow our application to grow from millions to potentially billions of fanatic customers.

The Opportunity

This role will involve working across a variety of technologies, including Native , Flutter , and related frameworks . We are looking for a Mobile Engineer with solid experience to join the App Core team — a cross-impact engineering team responsible for building and maintaining the core infrastructure of the mobile application, optimizing our performance, and enabling product teams to deliver high-quality mobile experiences.

  • Strong technical background with Flutter and/or native mobile development (Android/iOS).
  • Solid understanding of mobile software engineering principles, architectural patterns, and modularization strategies.
  • Experience with performance optimization, dependency injection, and migration of core systems.
  • Knowledge of mobile observability, monitoring, and debugging tools.
  • Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Track record of delivering results in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
Nice to Have

Why Join Us

title: Host Broadcast Production Manager
description:
Host Broadcast Production Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament.

This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the on-going development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On-going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast-related overlay. As well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on-site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio De Janeiro FIFA office, Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre-planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.
YOUR PROFILE
  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high-pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high-quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.

Pioneira no país em gestão de serviços oncológicos, aOncoclínicas&Co foi fundada em 2010 e hoje é um dos maiores centros de oncologia, hematologia e radioterapia da América Latina.

Na essência daOncoclínicas&Co , o paciente é o centro de tudo. É para ele que buscamos os mais avançados tratamentos e o mais alto nível de qualidade e segurança. Temos como pilares de atuação o acolhimento e a inovação no tratamento oncológico e a atenção integral e personalizada, com um olhar no indivíduo.

Aqui naOncoclínicas&Co valorizamos a diversidade e buscamos promover uma cultura inclusiva onde as pessoas se sintam pertencentes. Acreditamos que a inovação nasce de um ambiente diverso, com diferentes perspectivas e vivências.

  • Desejável pós em áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência na gestão de pessoas, processos e indicadores de atendimento, ciclo da conta, manutenção - clínica/hospitalar;
  • Conhecimento em indicadores e Power BI;
Local e horário de trabalho:

Pesando em seu desenvolvimento, oferecemos oPROGRAMA MAIS SABER – que proporciona descontos, conforme rede conveniada, em instituições de ensino superior e escolas de idiomas.

Para contribuir com sua saúde oferecemos oCLUDE SAÚDE – Programa de serviços como Telemedicina e Telepsicologia oferecendo suporte e recursos para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental;

This position is responsible for the administration of CI’s financial accounting systems: Unit4 Business World and Concur. The Financial Applications Director ensures optimal use of these systems and their related applications and plays a leading role in the integration of these systems with other CI databases relating to financial data and processes. This role also provides training to users, maintains security, and troubleshoots application issues for both US and field-based staff.

    • Hands-on resolution of tickets, including documentation in the ticketing system and communication with affected staff and IT stakeholders.
    • Communication with software vendors for issues that cannot be resolved internally.
    • Management of other support staff and coordination with business process owners and other team members as needed to resolve tickets.
    • Oversee creation, maintenance, and termination of user accounts in financial systems. Conduct periodic security audits as required.
    • Create and manage complex workflow processes for appropriate systems, including troubleshooting and maintenance.
    • Design special-purpose reports and processes utilizing SQL Server, Business World reporting tools, or other tools as required for audits or other management uses. This includes Business World AG16’s (SQL-based customizations). Manage design, test, and maintain custom reports and forms in Business World using ARC (Agresso Report Creator). This includes complex reports such as the check and the purchase order form.
    • Create and maintain security roles for both menu and reporting (data) access.
  • System Maintenance, Enhancements, and Vendor Management

  • Lead or participate in identifying system improvements, modifications, and enhancements that will streamline processes, increase efficiency, and provide needed functionality.
  • Develop and maintain interfaces to other systems as needed.
  • Serve as the Business World applications ‘go-to’ person by researching software functionality, staying current on technology changes, and advising on best practices.
  • Test patches to ensure that they resolve issues as intended. Work with systems software vendors and CI’s IT department to facilitate the migration of patches to production that have passed testing. Create/maintain system configuration as needed to ensure optimal processing.
  • Maintain and manage relationships with financial systems, software, and service vendors to ensure strong working relationships, maximized levels of support, and efficient use of CI’s resources.
  • Documentation and Training
  • Develop and maintain financial systems SharePoint resource site(s) with relevant help materials for end users.

description:
Cybersecurity Solutions Engineer

The Cybersecurity Solutions Engineer is responsible for the administration, optimization, and continuous improvement of security technologies, while also serving as a Tier 3 escalation point for complex security incidents. This role bridges advanced incident response with hands‑on engineering of cybersecurity tools, ensuring seamless integration, effective threat detection, and rapid response capabilities. Acting as an extension of external Tier 1 and Tier 2 security operations, the engineer plays a critical role in enhancing the organization’s overall security posture through proactive monitoring, tool fine‑tuning, and strategic incident handling.

Security Tools Administration
  • Administer and optimize security tools, including SIEM, EDR/XDR (Microsoft Defender), firewalls, vulnerability management, email and identity security solutions.
  • Ensure seamless integration of security tools with IT and cloud environments for continuous monitoring and threat detection.
  • Maintain security policies, configurations, and automation rules to improve operational efficiency and reduce false positives.
  • Manage log sources, data ingestion pipelines, and correlation rules within SIEM to enhance security visibility.
Security Operations & Incident Response
  • Act as a Tier 3 escalation point for security incidents requiring advanced investigation and resolution.
  • Conduct deep‑dive forensic analysis and threat‑hunting activities to detect and mitigate sophisticated threats.
  • Support the SOC team and external Tier 1 & Tier 2 analysts by providing expertise on complex security incidents.
  • Enhance and refine incident response playbooks, ensuring effective collaboration across all security layers.
  • Align incident response efforts with cybersecurity frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, and ISO 27001.
Threat Intelligence & Vulnerability Management
  • Analyze threat intelligence feeds and proactively adjust defenses based on evolving attack techniques.
  • Coordinate vulnerability assessments, collaborate with IT teams, and track remediation efforts to mitigate risks.
  • Perform proactive threat‑hunting activities to identify potential security gaps before they are exploited.
  • Ensure compliance with patch management policies and security best practices.
Requirements
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • At least 3 years of experience in security tools administration, incident response, or security operations.
  • Experience in listed companies, large‑scale enterprises, or multi‑geographical organizations is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of Microsoft Security solutions.
  • Hands‑on experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, firewalls, and security automation tools.
  • Proficiency in threat intelligence, forensic analysis, and malware analysis.
  • Strong understanding of network security, log analysis, and cloud security.
  • Experience with vulnerability management solutions.
  • CISSP, GCIA, GCIH, Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst, or equivalent.
  • Availability to travel internationally.
Soft Skills
  • Problem‑solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong ability to explain technical issues to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working cross‑functionally with IT, cloud, and development teams, as well as external security partners.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Resilient.
  • Willingness to stay current with evolving cybersecurity threats and technologies.
  • Ability to manage multiple security incidents and projects simultaneously.

Being a Model Auditor at Nubank is different from being a traditional auditor. title: General Manager
description:
Overview

Fairmont Hotels is a globally renowned luxury brand, celebrated for creating unforgettable memories for our guests. With more than 30,000 colleagues worldwide, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional service, embracing innovation, and fostering a culture of excellence.

Hotel Overview

Perched on the world-famous Copacabana Beach, the Fairmont Copacabana is one of Rio de Janeiro’s most prestigious luxury addresses and a symbol of the city’s glamorous lifestyle. With 375 rooms and suites, many offering panoramic views of the ocean and Sugar Loaf Mountain, the hotel blends timeless elegance with the vibrant energy of Rio.

As a leading destination for both leisure and business travelers, the hotel boasts extensive meeting and event spaces, hosting everything from high-profile international conferences to glamorous weddings and social gatherings. With its enviable beachfront location, modern design infused with local culture, and a legacy of warm Brazilian hospitality, the Fairmont Copacabana embodies the art de vivre of Fairmont while standing as an icon of Rio de Janeiro’s luxury hotel scene.

Job Description

As the General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana , you will embody the essence of luxury hospitality. Your dynamic and hands-on approach is fueled by a deep passion for developing people and fostering an entrepreneurial spirit. A true brand and guest ambassador, you will challenge conventions, consistently seek solutions, and infuse innovation into every facet of the hotel experience and every function of the business.

Your seasoned leadership style will blend diplomacy with relationship-building prowess, cultivating strong connections with both internal and external stakeholders, including Owners and the Community. Your ability to engage with ownership and strategize revenue enhancements will be coupled with an innate talent for envisioning the hotel's long-term trajectory.

A refined sense of finance and business acumen will be at the core of your decision-making, grounded in an unwavering commitment to delivering a world-class product and service. By seamlessly weaving local heritage and culture into our offerings, you will not only create an authentic guest experience but also drive excellence across all dimensions of our operations.

In your role as a catalyst for exceptional service, you will uphold the highest standards, infusing every interaction with the kind of genuine care that leaves an indelible mark on our guests. Nurturing an environment of continuous growth and skill development, you will inspire our colleagues to consistently exceed expectations, turning moments into memories for every visitor.

As a visionary leader, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our strategic direction. Your involvement in goal setting and objective communication will propel business growth and solidify the hotel’s reputation as a distinguished luxury destination. Your ability to foster positive relationships with ownership will ensure a harmonious partnership that aligns with our overarching strategy while enhancing the hotel's performance and prestige.

Your leadership will be synonymous with setting industry benchmarks and redefining luxury hospitality. Your commitment to excellence, coupled with your innovative approach, will leave an enduring mark on our iconic brand and create a legacy of unparalleled guest memories.

Reporting Structure
The General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana will report to the Cluster Delegate Manager for Rio de Janeiro Luxury Hotels , as part of the unique cluster structure that unites Accor’s flagship luxury properties in the city.

Qualifications

Key Behaviours and Responsibilities:

  • 1. Act with an open mindset:
    Embrace innovative ideas, adapt to change, and encourage a culture of innovation and continuous learning. Demonstrate explicit knowledge and awareness of company standards as an integral role model. Build quality relationships with the management team. Create an environment that encourages innovation, challenges traditional thinking, and fosters a "speak-up" culture.
  • 2. Create positive impact working with others:
    Foster an inclusive and collaborative work environment, empowering colleagues to contribute their best and building strong relationships based on trust and respect. Create a collaborative and inclusive environment where all colleagues are encouraged to provide input. Actively listen to team members' ideas, concerns, and feedback and incorporate their input into decision-making processes. Recognize and appreciate the contributions and well-being of colleagues.
  • 3. Strive for guest/client satisfaction:
    Exhibits a deep understanding of the luxury hospitality landscape and guest expectations, ensuring that the guest experience consistently exceeds industry standards. Maintain product and service quality standards by conducting ongoing evaluations. Handle VIP Guests and understand international protocols for government officials and royalty. Monitor guest/client feedback, address concerns promptly, and implement improvements to optimize satisfaction.
  • 4. Consistently deliver excellence:
    Demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of ownership group's investment objectives and formulates strategic business plans that align with those objectives; ensuring preservation and maximization of the hotel’s assets. Set high performance standards, lead by example, and drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality across all the hotel. Exhibits expertise in sales, marketing, and revenue management, driving the hotel's performance in the luxury hospitality market. Maximize financial performance, control costs, and execute marketing and operational activities that produce results meeting or exceeding the hotel's business plan. Recognize and reward outstanding performance and celebrate achievements within the organization.
  • 5. Enable team success:
    Support the professional growth and development of colleagues through coaching, mentoring, and providing opportunities for learning. Encourage individuals to take on challenging assignments and stretch their capabilities. Provide regular feedback and guidance, recognizing achievements and offering constructive suggestions for improvement. Create a safe and empowering environment where individuals feel comfortable taking risks, expressing their ideas, and learning from failures. As applicable, brings experience in working with labor unions, maintaining constructive relationships and ensuring harmonious teamwork.
  • 6. Create clarity:
    Articulates a clear and comprehensive vision for the hotel, aligning goals and objectives with ownership group's investment strategy. Effectively communicates organizational vision, goals, and expectations, fostering a shared sense of purpose and direction among team members. Demonstrates adeptness in overseeing renovation projects, maintaining transparency and open communication throughout the process. Addresses ambiguity and navigates complex situations with transparency, fostering an environment of clear direction and effective problem-solving.
  • 7. Inspire for top performance:
    Lead with passion and integrity, motivate and inspire others to achieve their best. Market plans and ideas successfully, reducing key and complex ideas and messages to clear, memorable, and compelling statements. Embodies an entrepreneurial spirit, inspiring innovative thinking and fostering a culture that encourages taking calculated risks. Recognizes and rewards outstanding performance, cultivating an atmosphere of achievement and recognition. Promotes continuous development and growth, offering resources and guidance to nurture professional skills and talents. Champions a "speak-up" culture, creating an environment where diverse opinions are valued, and individual contributions are celebrated. Convince others, negotiate, debate, and find win-win solutions.
Additional Information
  • Prior experience in a luxury hotel General Manager position, in large hotel(s) (mandatory)
  • Strong educational background with professional qualifications and a continuous learning mindset.
  • Fluent in English and in Portuguese or Spanish (mandatory)
  • Experience in working in Latin America, preferably in Brazil (mandatory)
  • Proven track record of building a strong service, and quality culture
  • Strong people skills and a track record of fostering positive, inclusive, high-performing cultures.
  • Experience in managing owner relations.
  • Demonstrated leadership, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strategic thinker with excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Displays a strong entrepreneurial spirit
  • Bottom-line oriented with a focus on quality guest service and team-building.
  • Creative and innovative mindset.
  • Ability to collaborate and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent sense of prioritization and time management.
  • Professional demeanor and strategic orientation.
  • Engaging, friendly, and charismatic with a natural ability to connect with guests.

Transformar vidas com saúde é o que nos move!

Atuamos em todo o Brasil por meio de duas unidades de negócios, Amil e Rede Total Care, com mais de 1.500 hospitais credenciados e uma rede própria de hospitais, clínicas, centros de tratamento, home care e transporte médico.

Com uma missão clara e valores sólidos, fortalecemos nossa cultura com compromisso de servir sempre melhor. Cuidamos das nossas pessoas colaboradoras para que esse cuidado se reflita na população que atendemos.

Reforçamos que não solicitamos pagamentos, taxas ou códigos SMS em nossos processos seletivos. Todas as oportunidades estão disponíveis em nossos canais oficiais e no nosso site de carreira. Qualquer situação diferente deve ser denunciada.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Engajar, influenciar, negociar e trabalhar em conjunto com sua equipe e com as lideranças das unidades construindo a Cultura de Segurança de pessoas e processos na UHH, sendo exemplo no cumprimento dos requisitos aplicáveis para todos na unidade de atuação.
  • Cumprir com a gestão da rotina da unidade, tais como: NR 32, CIPA, PAE, Brigada de Incêndio, Simulados de Emergência, AVCB, acidentes de trabalho, checklists realizados, treinamentos, PGR – NR 01, PRGS/ PGRSS, etc, acompanhando e reportando os processos de auditoria interna e externa, bem como as visitas e fiscalizações de autoridades públicas.

  • Apoiar na elaboração, cumprir e controlar a política de EPI nas unidades sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Realizar a gestão e controle dos sistemas de prevenção e combate a incêndio para assegurar que estejam em plenas condições de funcionamento, corretamente instalados e com as análises periódicas dentro da validade e de acordo com o projeto de combate a incêndio da unidade, bem como a execução de todos processos e fluxos de incêndio.
  • Avaliar previamente os requisitos para execução de atividades perigosas (trabalho em altura, eletricidade, espaços confinados, energias perigosas, trabalho a quente, escavação, elevação e suspensão de cargas, etc), elaborando a APR (Analise Preliminar de Risco) e a PT (Permissão do Trabalho) antes do início das atividades e que elas sejam realizadas de acordo com a legislação vigente, com as diretrizes definidas pela UHG e com requisitos de acreditação / certificação e assessment relacionados a área.
  • Participar ativamente de todas as investigações de incidentes e acidentes, com o objetivo de identificar as causas raízes, propor planos de ação para evitar a recorrência, bem como compartilhar os aprendizados, reportando mensalmente os dados de acidentes do trabalho, doenças ocupacionais e agentes insalubres das unidades sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Dar suporte para implementação de todos os projetos de inovação para a melhoria dos processos de Segurança do Trabalho por meio de visitas técnicas, desenvolvimento de controle, levantamento de dados e outras atuações de forma a alavancar resultados da Segurança e das áreas parceiras, tais como meio ambiente, saúde e qualidade de vida nas suas unidades.
  • Realizar a gestão de documentação e atividades perigosas das subcontratadas ao que tange diretrizes de Segurança do Trabalho, controlando a documentação e inspecionando as atividades, a fim de buscar a padronização nos documentos e dos processos.

Nós somos a Karoon Energy Brasil, seja muito bem-vindo(a)!

A Karoon Energy é uma empresa internacional de exploração e produção de petróleo e gás natural, com projetos no Brasil, no Golfo do México e na Austrália, com ações listadas na bolsa de valores da Austrália.

A companhia detém e opera 100% do Campo de Baúna , localizado ao sul da Bacia de Santos, que compreende os reservatórios de Baúna, Piracaba e Patola. A companhia também detém os campos de Neon e Goiá , e o bloco S-M-1537, todos ao sul da Bacia de Santos .

No Golfo da América , a companhia tem uma participação não-operacional de 30% nos campos de petróleo e gás Who Dat e Dome Patrol, 16% no campo Abilene, assim como variadas participações em infraestrutura na área de exploração na costa da Louisiana (EUA).

Nossa visão é ser uma companhia líder e independente de energia, capaz de se adaptar a um mundo dinâmico de maneira inovadora e empreendedora. Nosso propósito é fornecer energia de forma segura, responsável, criando benefícios duradouros para todos os seus stakeholders.

description:
At Zyte , we make the world’s web data accessible to everyone. Our technology powers data extraction at scale, helping businesses and researchers unlock the full potential of the web.

We’re a remote-first, multicultural team of engineers, data scientists, and innovators who believe in curiosity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you’re passionate about building reliable AI systems and improving the quality of web data, we’d love to hear from you.

About the Role

As a Machine Learning Engineer (Web Data Quality) , you’ll design and implement intelligent systems that automatically detect, measure, and improve the quality of large-scale web datasets. You’ll work at the intersection of data science, AI, and distributed systems , collaborating closely with product, engineering, and data teams to make data accuracy measurable, scalable, and actionable.

What You’ll Do
  • Develop and deploy ML models for anomaly detection, schema drift, and content validation
  • Build and improve data quality pipelines leveraging modern data and MLOps tools
  • Design and optimize embeddings and GenAI models to enhance data consistency
  • Collaborate with engineers to integrate AI systems into production workflows
  • Conduct experiments, evaluate performance, and iterate for continuous improvement
  • Stay up to date on AI/ML and GenAI research to guide innovation within Zyte
Required

  • Strong Python skills and experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn)
  • Experience with data validation, anomaly detection, or data quality systems
  • Familiarity with data pipelines (Airflow, Spark, or similar)
  • Understanding of model evaluation, metrics, and deployment best practices
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills
Preferred
  • Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or GenAI model orchestration
  • Familiarity with data labeling tools and active learning approaches
  • Contributions to open-source or public ML projects
  • Experience working in a remote, cross-functional team environment
  • 35 days of paid time off
  • Health & wellness support
  • Inclusive and supportive team environment
  • Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe.

About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper-focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You'll work on our Performance Creative service—our AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

description:

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

  • Qualidade
  • Responsabilidade Social
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Atender as normativas do Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN);
  • Registrar junto ao Conselho de classe (COREN) a responsabilidade técnica da unidade;
  • Compor Comissões como as de prontuário e PGRSS;
  • Supervisionar e garantir o cumprimento das atividades de sua área e participar das atividades integradas com as demais áreas;
  • Avaliar e acompanhar a produtividade de enfermagem de acordo com os parâmetros estabelecidos;
  • Realizar o dimensionamento do quadro de pessoal da equipe de enfermagem para a qualidade na assistência prestada;
  • Realizar reuniões periódicas com a equipe de enfermagem para discussão técnicas e administrativas e também ações corretivas e educativas, motivadas pelas não conformidades identificadas nos registros de assistência;
  • Assegurar que a assistência de Enfermagem seja prestada seguindo os preceitos de segurança, de forma humanizada e individualizada;
  • Avaliar periodicamente o nível de qualificação técnica dos empregados de sua responsabilidade e manter o controle sobre a assiduidade e disciplina dos mesmos;
  • Participar da elaboração das rotinas dos serviços de enfermagem em conjunto com o Gestor bem como mantê-las atualizada;
  • Supervisionar o cumprimento de normas e recomendações estabelecidas pelo Controle de Infecção Hospitalar nos serviços de saúde colaborando para o controle de infecção;
  • Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem.
  • Experiência mínima de 02 (dois) anos comprovada em Gestão de equipe de Enfermagem.
  • Especialização Completa em Gestão Hospitalar, Gestão de Saúde, ou áreas afins.
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.
  • Trabalho 100% presencial;
  • Local de trabalho: Centro do Rio;

Somos uma empresa que, em um curto espaço de tempo, construiu uma sólida reputação no setor da engenharia e construção. Estamos conectadoscom as principais inovações, formados por um time com vasta experiência e reconhecimento no mercado.

Grupo DR1 Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Técnico de Segurança Operacional

Você se considera um profissional fora da curva?

Se a resposta for sim, essa vaga é para você.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Técnico(a) de Segurança Operacional para reforçar nosso compromisso com a segurança das equipes e operações, tanto em campo quanto no ambiente corporativo.

Sobre a empresa

O Grupo DR1 é uma empresa especializada em prestação de serviços através de soluções integradas utilizando drones. Somos uma empresa líder de mercado de inspeção com drones e conseguimos isso graças a uma equipe focada em eficiência e resultados, movidos pelo seu espírito desafiador, jovem e dinâmico.

Para saber mais acesse: .

Principais Atividades
  • Conduzir debriefings de operações, consolidando métricas e lições aprendidas;
  • Emitir e acompanhar feedbacks de logística relacionados às operações;
  • Gerir ações pós-incidente/acidente/desvio, garantindo implementação de medidas corretivas;
  • Controlar e manter atualizadas as documentações de QSMS;
  • Acompanhar não conformidades e coordenar planos de fechamento;
  • Organizar e conduzir reuniões quinzenais de segurança, registrando temas e ações definidas;
  • Apoiar a gestão de risco, incluindo atualização da matriz de risco e comprovação de ciência por parte de todos os colaboradores;
  • Realizar análises aleatórias de logs de voo;
  • Verificar semanalmente os Stop Cards, controlando as ações dos mais relevantes;
  • Participar de reuniões iniciais de serviços (kick-off), reforçando diretrizes de segurança;
  • Acompanhar e apoiar operações em campo, com foco em segurança operacional;
  • Elaborar e ministrar treinamentos periódicos de segurança operacional (onshore e offshore);
  • Conduzir inspeções de campo e auditorias internas em áreas de risco, emitindo relatórios e recomendações;
  • Atuar como facilitador de programas de cultura de segurança, incentivando reporte de desvios e boas práticas;
  • Monitorar e reportar indicadores de performance em segurança (KPIs de QSMS), com análise crítica e propostas de melhoria;
  • Apoiar no planejamento e execução de simulados de emergência (incêndio, abandono, primeiros socorros);
  • Garantir conformidade com legislações, NRs e normas internacionais (ANAC, DECEA, RBAC 94, ABS/DNV, ISO 45001, ISO 14001);
  • Controlar e manter atualizados os EPIs e EPCs, garantindo rastreabilidade de inspeções e validade de certificados;
  • Participar de investigações de incidentes/acidentes, aplicando metodologias reconhecidas (árvore de causas, 5 porquês, ICAM);
  • Auxiliar na gestão de jornada e fadiga de operadores em deslocamentos terrestres ou offshore;
  • Apoiar a área de operações na gestão de mudanças (MOC – Management of Change), garantindo que alterações operacionais tenham análise de risco prévia.
Qualificações
  • Formação Técnica em Segurança do Trabalho (registro ativo obrigatório);
  • Conhecimento em QSMS, gestão de riscos, incidentes e auditorias internas;
  • Experiência em operações de alto risco (óleo e gás, mineração, energia ou setores similares);
  • Vivência com sistemas de gestão integrados (QSMS/HSE Management Systems);
  • Capacidade de elaborar relatórios técnicos, métricas e controles de segurança;
  • Habilidade para conduzir toolbox talks e briefings de segurança em campo;
  • CNH categoria B válida e disponibilidade para viagens onshore e offshore;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado será considerado diferencial;
  • Diferenciais opcionais: cursos CBSP e T-HUET para operações offshore.
Leia com atenção todo o descritivo da vaga! Salário + Benefícios
  • Salário a combinar;
  • Vale Alimentação e Vale Transporte;
  • Plano de Saúde (com possibilidade de inclusão de dependentes).
